snippet.title: Ravenswatch | Songs of Thieves Free Update Teaser
snippet.description:
Play Ravenswatch now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071280/Ravenswatch/

IT'S AN AMBUSH! THIEVES ARE COMING TO REVERIE!
- New enemy faction: the Thieves!
- Thieves' Stashes, including Treasure rooms, Trap rooms, Cursed rooms, and Mirror rooms...
- Magical Harps and their swift Melodies...
- Stingy Jack, a new threat to your loot!
- Multiplayer Pause
- And more!

Learn everything in the latest Content Highlights:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2071280/view/508483852893686081

The Songs of Thieves Update will be available for free on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch on May 27th, 2026!
